deviations.reason: The plan predicted candidate 900 would emit admit when batched with 902. Because the fixture must copy tasks 900/902/906/907 verbatim from live state.json, and 900 has a genuine independent cross-batch collision with 906 (shared skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md scope, no dependencies[] edge), a correct implementation defers 900 against 906 rather than admitting it. The test asserts this correct, real behavior instead, while still proving the in-batch direction rule via 902's line (defer against 900, in_batch).
